title: Storm Lantern - SE Implementation Scratchpad
content: Context / goal:\nQuick-running scratchpad for the Nimbus Retail private deployment — focused on getting the first tenant up and healthy in staging, then plan a canary rollout to prod with traffic shaping and model fallbacks. This is intentionally messy; things to capture during pairing with customer SEs and infra.
notes: Customer: Nimbus Retail (ecom analytics + in-store receipts). Want on-prem-like private deployment; strict data residency (EU region), KMS-based envelope encryption, and 99.9% inference uptime SLA. Primary model workload: 2 active LLM routes (chat v1.2, embeddings v0.9) plus a reranker for recommendations. Expected steady QPS: 35 qps; peak 120 qps.
open_questions:
- Confirm whether Nimbus wants 'shared control plane' or fully isolated control plane.
- Do they need HSM integration now or later? (asked security on 2025-11-05)
- Which team will own the AWS account networking vs. Redwood-managed VPN?
- Can they accept egress through our transit gateway (compliance check in flight)?
networking_todo:
1) Get VPC CIDR ranges from Nimbus (asked: 10.10.0.0/16 tentative).
2) Plan peering: prefer AWS Transit Gateway + VPC endpoint for control plane traffic.
3) Security group rules: open ports 443 (control), 22 (ops ssh - restricted), 10250-10260 (k8s node ports for metrics - restricted to ops CIDR).
4) Subnets: deploy serving nodes across 3 AZs for high availability — make sure AZ mapping aligns with their on-prem cross-connect.
Commands / quick notes:
- aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.10.0.0/16
- terraform: module "nimbus-vpc" -> use aws_vpc + tgw attachments (see template PR #78)
- Check route tables: ensure 0.0.0.0/0 still via customer NAT for outbound logging to their SIEM
kms_and_keys:
- KMS alias convention: alias/redwood/nimbus/<env>/model-keys
- Create CustomerMasterKey with key policy allowing their security account + Redwood SE IAM role
- Envelope encryption: runtime uses CMK to unwrap token, model artifact encrypted with S3 SSE-C or SSE-KMS depending on their preference
Snippets:
- aws kms create-key --description "Nimbus staging model CMK"
- alias: alias/redwood/nimbus/staging/model-cmk
serving_and_models:
Model mapping:
- chat-v1.2: 8xA100 partition, quantized int8 recommended after initial run (monitor perplexity/regressions)
- embed-v0.9: 4xA40 cluster with batch sizes tuned for 128 concurrent small requests
- reranker: CPU elastic pool with burstable GPU for heavy ranking jobs
Runtime knobs to set initially:
- batching.window_ms: 15
- kv_cache.size: 12GB per shard
- fallback_policy: region->model-variant->dedicated-reserve
Rollout note: start with model-shadowing for 48h (collect embedding similarity deltas), then 5/95 canary to prod for 24h, 25/75 next 48h
observability:
Must wire: token-level cost (per-route), per-request latency buckets, and per-model quality regression alerts tied to eval prompt set.
Dashboards to create:
- Route: chat-v1.2 latency P50/P95/P99 by AZ
- Cost: tokens per request trend + cost per 1k tokens
- Quality: embedding drift histogram (week-over-week)
Tracing: add X-Redwood-Req header into their app logs for correlation
Quick queries:
- SELECT avg(latency) FROM traces WHERE route='chat-v1.2' AND env='staging' SINCE 48 HOURS
deployment_steps:
- STEP 0: Pre-call checklist (security sign-off, KMS policy, account numbers)
- STEP 1: Provision VPC and peering (ops), create KMS keys (infosec + customer)
- STEP 2: Deploy control plane components in their region (private control plane container set)
- STEP 3: Deploy serving runtime with reserved instances for initial steady QPS
- STEP 4: Smoke tests: 100 warmup requests to prime KV cache, 500 embedding calls to confirm throughput
- STEP 5: Shadow traffic run (0% user impact) for 48h, collect eval metrics
- STEP 6: Canary 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (per agreed windows)
Fallbacks: if P95 > 500ms or error rate > 0.5% rollback to smaller model variant or reroute to dedicated pool
quick_todo_list:
- [ ] Get final CIDR & AWS account IDs (action: Liam) - due 2025-11-06
- [ ] Confirm KMS HSM requirement (Priya) - due 2025-11-07
- [ ] Wire up Confluence onboarding page with our checklist (me) - due 2025-11-08
- [ ] Run initial perf run in staging (Marco) - due 2025-11-09
- [ ] Prepare customer-facing one-pager for rollout steps (me) - due 2025-11-10
meeting_notes_2025-11-05:
10:00 call w/ Nimbus infra + security. Key outcomes:
- They prefer our private control plane (managed) but require logs forwarded to their SIEM via a private collector.
- Will not approve HSM in first phase; KMS is fine for staging.
- Need SOC2 attestation documents; SE to attach next email.
Actionables: send SOC2 + network diagram (Evelyn) by EOD 11/05.
followups: - Attach SOC2 and privacy whitepaper to customer thread.\n- Create quick 'how to disable canary' playbook for their on-call.\n- Add a routing rule: if region latency > 1s for 5m, move traffic to fallback model-variant instantly.
end_state: Target: staging green with shadowing and dashboards configured by 2025-11-12, then 2-week monitored canary in prod window starting 2025-11-18.\nNotes to self: keep this doc live — will copy into Confluence when we have a more formal runbook.
